# BEACN NFT Studio

Public app: https://beacnpool.github.io/NFT-Studio/
Open source: https://github.com/BEACNpool/NFT-Studio
Cardano knowledge: https://github.com/BEACNpool/NFT-Studio/tree/main/knowledge
MCP documentation: https://github.com/BEACNpool/NFT-Studio/blob/main/docs/MCP.md

## Repository MCP

Setup/share page: https://beacnpool.github.io/NFT-Studio/mcp/
This is a static setup guide, NOT an HTTP MCP endpoint.
Clone https://github.com/BEACNpool/NFT-Studio and run:
  npm --prefix mcp ci
  npm --prefix mcp run build
Configure your MCP client with command node and args containing the absolute
checkout path to NFT-Studio/mcp/dist/cli.mjs. Transport: local stdio.
Node 22.13+ required. No extra model-provider credentials are needed by this MCP.
For Codex CLI, signed in with your existing login, run from the checkout:
  node mcp/install-codex.mjs --check
  node mcp/install-codex.mjs --install
  codex
This explicitly registers the built local server and refuses conflicting settings.
The repo includes .agents/skills/nft-studio/SKILL.md. Open Codex in the checkout
and ask: $nft-studio Create a pixel-art spaceship NFT and give me its review link.
Local server: 17 tools and 61 resources; use discovery for the running version.
Tools: studio_capabilities, search_knowledge, read_knowledge,
search_cip_sources, get_cip_source_chunk, validate_payload, validate_metadata,
create_mint_intent, verify_mint_intent, create_proof_record, verify_proof_record,
prepare_unsigned_transaction, verify_signed_transaction, apply_state_capsule_parameters,
create_music_release, verify_music_release, prepare_unsigned_music_transaction.
A separately deployable Worker has15tools. Operators supply their own HTTPS host.
No personal hosting address is advertised here.

Begin with studio_capabilities for current limits and evidence boundaries.
File inputs contain explicit canonical base64 bytes, never local paths or URLs.
The local server receives the content explicitly supplied by its client.
For an ordinary mint, return create_mint_intent.review.url exactly to the human.
It opens the exact content directly in Labs / Agent minting. Save packetJson
under its suggested filename as a file-import fallback. The URL fragment holds
the same content as the file; share only with intended reviewers. Studio clears
it from the current history entry before parsing and verifying content hashes.
The user inspects the files, connects a compatible browser wallet, reviews the
transaction and approves signing/submission. Opening a link takes none of those
wallet actions. Never reconstruct a truncated URL.
Studio platform fee: 0 ADA. Cardano network fees still apply, and minimum ADA
kept with the NFT remains in the user's output. An AI subscription does not
fund those costs. A request, signature or submitted hash is not a confirmed mint.
prepare_unsigned_transaction receives an explicitly authorized CIP-30 change
address and UTxO snapshot and builds native NFT/data unsigned CBOR. The local server receives that snapshot; it does not prove wallet ownership or
unspent chain state. Ordinary Node preparation retains a bounded temporary packet
for external-witness verification; the Worker is stateless. An external signer must
independently check the complete signed transaction and current inputs.
For files with music credits, call create_music_release and save packetJson
exactly. Its review.url opens Labs / Music release. verify_music_release checks
that same canonical packet. Music packages are distinct from ordinary mint
intents and the ordinary unsigned preparation tool does not accept them.
prepare_unsigned_music_transaction instead takes canonical packetJson and an
explicitly authorized wallet snapshot. It returns stateless unsigned music CBOR
with the full package hash, exact metadata, fees and conservation checks. Both
Node and Worker Music responses have no packetId and cannot enter the Node
stored-witness verifier. Its wallet snapshot is disclosed to this service;
ownership, current unspent state and signing authority are not established.
Retain packetJson for fresh visible Music Lab wallet review.
apply_state_capsule_parameters applies only the pinned experimental Capsule
program to an exact seed/name; it returns script identity and blueprint, not a
live mint transaction or proof that the seed exists.
No tool signs, submits or connects to a wallet.

## Evidence boundaries

CIP proposal status and Studio implementation evidence are separate.
Read nft-studio://implementations for dated capabilities, test environments,
immutable source links and limitations. read_knowledge gives related record IDs.
This source revision exposes 61 fixed resources; it never fetches evidence URLs.
Hashes verify exact bytes, not authorship, ownership, rights or chain inclusion.
State capsules are experimental contracts; the browser demonstration is local.
Proof records use the public hash profile of proposed CIP-190; export is not
publication or a blockchain timestamp.
The separately installed Node MCP can prepare unsigned transactions and verify
external signatures. It never holds a signing key or submits a transaction.

Original CIP sources: search_cip_sources searches id/title/status in 148 pinned README originals; get_cip_source_chunk returns bounded inert UTF-8 chunks with attribution. This is separate from 58 curated entries/73 reviewed primary sources. Excludes annexes, CPS and off-repository links. Guide: https://github.com/BEACNpool/NFT-Studio/blob/main/docs/CIP_SOURCE_ACCESS.md
